name: Progress M-07M
about: Progress M-07M (2010-044A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2010 Sep 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2010 Sep 10), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
